title: api-convert feature has implicit sanitize coupling
description: fieldwork-db's api-convert feature enables fieldwork/sanitize to get access to fieldwork::util::epoch_to_iso (used in articles_db.rs line 542). This works but is fragile: the dependency is on epoch_to_iso (which needs chrono, not ammonia), but the feature gate pulls in the full sanitize stack (ammonia, pulldown-cmark, chrono). If util is ever refactored to separate the time utilities from the HTML sanitization utilities, api-convert would silently break. The coupling should be made explicit or the time utilities should be extracted to their own feature.
close_reason: Accepted: api-convert enabling sanitize is a consequence of xzkb.24. All consumers already have sanitize via 'full' feature.
